g.text: Load cell wire colours: red E+, black E-, green A+, white A-. Check them against your own cell.

g.desc: Load cell wire colours: red E+, black E-, green A+, white A-. Check them against your own cell.

g.text: VCC and VDD are shorted at every HX711. Both go to 3V3.

g.desc: VCC and VDD are shorted at every HX711. Both go to 3V3.

g.text: Every board-to-board net is a named label: 3V3, GND, SCK, and one BINn_DT data line per cell.

g.desc: Every board-to-board net is a named label: 3V3, GND, SCK, and one BINn_DT data line per cell.

g.text: 3V3, GND and SCK are split 1-to-4 by a PCT-215 lever connector per rail, per island.

g.desc: 3V3, GND and SCK are split 1-to-4 by a PCT-215 lever connector per rail, per island.

g.text: D3 to D6 read the left island, bins 0, 1, 4, 5. D7 to D10 read the right island, bins 2, 3, 6, 7.

g.desc: D3 to D6 read the left island, bins 0, 1, 4, 5. D7 to D10 read the right island, bins 2, 3, 6, 7.
